decision.reasoning_trace: Based on the product feed, the consideration set consists of the top-rated mechanical keyboards with high review counts and good customer reviews. The final choice is the YMDK GH60 GK61 RGB Hot Swap Independent Driver Tyce-C ANSI Mechanical Keyboard DIY kit, which has a high rating of 4.4 and over 700 reviews. This keyboard offers a lot of customization options and is a good choice for those who want to build their own mechanical keyboard.
